input.story: Bhai maine 8 October 2026 ko UPI se 15000 bheje, paise account se kat gaye par receiver ko nahi mile. Bank ko complaint ki, 3 hafte ho gaye koi jawab nahi. Kya karun?

case.problem_subtype: failed UPI transaction refund not processed
case.summary: The user transferred 15000 via UPI on 8 October 2026, but the amount was debited without reaching the receiver. Although the bank was notified, no response has been received after 3 weeks.
case.user_goal: Get a refund of the failed UPI transaction amount from the bank.

timeline.event: Transferred 15000 via UPI which was debited but not received by the payee
Raised a complaint with the bank

follow_up_questions: Aap kaunse state mein rehte hain?
Kya aapke paas bank complaint number ya complaint ki copy hai?
Kya aapne UPI app (jaise Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) par bhi ticket raise kiya tha?

notes: A Consumer Commission can also award compensation and litigation costs - we don't estimate that figure; it depends on the case.
Interest on delayed money may be claimable; the rate is for a lawyer/court to decide, so we don't add it here.

assessment.where_user_stands: Aapka 15000 ka amount failed UPI transaction mein debit ho gaya hai aur abhi tak wapas nahi mila, jo ki ek banking service deficiency hai [KB:cpa_consumer_def]. Aapke paas bank transaction record hai, jo ek strong proof hai. Aapka case ka time limit bhi safe hai kyunki Consumer complaints 2 saal ke andar file ki ja sakti hain [KB:cpa_limitation], aur RBI rules ke mutabik bank ki taraf se reply na milne par aap Ombudsman ke paas ja sakte hain [KB:rbi_ios_2026]. Lekin abhi aapke paas bank complaint number ya ticket reference missing hai, jo ki agle steps ke liye zaroori hai.

options.title: Bank aur UPI App se follow-up karein
options.what_to_do: Apne bank aur UPI app (jaise Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) par dobara contact karke complaint number ya ticket reference lein.

options.title: RBI Ombudsman [KB:rbi_ios_2026] par complaint karein
options.what_to_do: Agar bank 30 din ke andar jawab na de ya refund na kare, toh cms.rbi.org.in par online complaint darj karein [KB:rbi_ios_2026].

options.title: National Consumer Helpline [KB:forum_nch] (NCH)
options.what_to_do: NCH helpline 1915 par call karein ya consumerhelpline.gov.in par apni shikayat darj karein [KB:forum_nch].

proof_tips: Bank ke customer care se baat karte waqt call recording rakhein ya email par written mein baat karein.
UPI app ke history section se transaction ID ka screenshot zaroor save karke rakhein.
what_i_dont_know: Kya bank ki taraf se koi internal technical error ki wajah se delay hua hai.
Kya aapne UPI app par bhi alag se ticket raise kiya tha ya nahi.
assessment.needs_lawyer_reason: Yeh ek simple failed UPI transaction ka mamla hai jise aap khud bank, NCH, ya RBI Ombudsman [KB:rbi_ios_2026] ke zariye solve kar sakte hain. Iske liye abhi lawyer ki zaroorat nahi hai.
assessment.reply: Aapka 15,000 rupaye ka UPI transaction fail hone ke baad bhi account se debit ho gaya hai aur bank ne abhi tak koi response nahi diya hai. Yeh banking service mein deficiency maani ja sakti hai [KB:cpa_consumer_def]. Aapke paas transaction record hai jo ki ek accha proof hai. Sabse pehle aapko bank se contact karke complaint number ya ticket reference lena chahiye. Agar bank 30 din ke andar action na le, toh aap RBI Ombudsman portal (cms.rbi.org.in) par free mein complaint darj kar sakte hain [KB:rbi_ios_2026]. Kya aapne apne UPI app (jaise Google Pay ya PhonePe) par bhi iski koi complaint ya ticket raise kiya hai?
